evidence: Carries the Wallet label, modifies wallet PSBT filling in src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.cpp, and updates descriptor extraction interfaces.
rationale: Populating PSBT_GLOBAL_XPUB resolves real-world hardware wallet signing failures and removes external coordinator workarounds. Author testing shows devices like BitBox02 simulator refuse multisig signing without this field ('This BitBox02 is not one of the cosigners'), and coordinators like Specter Desktop maintain dedicated workarounds to inject it.
